intro: Silv keeps your essentials within reach and your room looking refined. With tinted glass and shelf storage, it's smart, subtle, and space-conscious.

features.title: Toughened, tinted, and timeless
features.text: The brown-tinted glass top adds a warm tone while being resistant to everyday knocks and scratches.

features.title: Warmth that grounds the space
features.text: The cinnamon wood finish adds richness and calm, pairing beautifully with modern or classic interiors.

features.title: Storage you’ll actually use
features.text: With open shelves below, our corner table lets you store or show off books, candles, or consoles—without looking bulky.

features.title: Our table fits in, beautifully
features.text: With a wall-friendly back design, our table nestles neatly against flat surfaces—making the most of your space without ever getting in the way.

features.title: Sized just right for corners
features.text: With a modest footprint, Silv is designed to fit into tight spots and small rooms without compromise.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
